info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Documents-v4-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Documents Retrieval API allows clients to access and retrieve documents related to auto insurance quotes. This endpoint provides essential documentation that can help consumers review their insurance options and understand policy details. Typical users include insurance agents, brokers, and customers seeking to make informed decisions about their auto insurance policies. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate document retrieval functionalities into their applications, enhancing user experience and facilitating efficient insurance management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents associated with quotes.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access all documents linked to various quotes within the system. It provides a comprehensive overview of the documentation available, enabling users to efficiently manage their quote-related materials.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving quote documents. This request expects a JSON payload that adheres to the defined schema for fetching documents based on specific query parameters.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of quotes documents.

ListAutoInsuranceQuotesDocumentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to documents in the quotes system. It expects a string input.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the request.

resultId.description: The identifier of the resultant document.

state.description: The current state of the document processing.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the request.

audit.description: Audit information related to the request.

ListAutoInsuranceQuotesDocumentsResponse.description: Response schema for the successful retrieval of document quotes.

createdBy.description: The user who created the document.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the document was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the document creation was automated.

Audit.description: Schema representing audit information related to the request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value can help in analyzing the performance of the API.
